purpose: identical packet handed to A4/A5/A6 before any proposal is written; outcome-blind: no per-arm result files exist anywhere in the tree at freeze time (budget 0/6)
mission: Does point-in-time conditioning from newly adopted free sources - SEC filing-clock fundamentals aggregated to the frozen sector cohort, and vintage-dated macro - produce incremental, after-cost information beyond SPY/sector beta on the authorized 12-ETF universe?

binding_rules.count: exactly two proposals per agent, six total, outcome-blind
binding_rules.pit_conditioning_quota: at least 3 of 6 proposals must condition on adopted PIT sources; with FRED/ALFRED BLOCKED this means SEC filing-clock fundamentals via research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.py
binding_rules.forbidden: PLAN_stocks_v5.md section 1 items 1-7 + stocks_free_v5_run/forbidden_family_inventory.json are binding; a proposal inside any entry is INELIGIBLE regardless of prose
binding_rules.section_1_1_front_door: vol-level confirmatory re-entry allowed ONLY with ex-ante risk overlay, confirmatory preregistration, own stale-rank-style falsification control, |rho| <= 0.20 vs the V4 semivariance shape anchor measured by A7-N, documented level-axis relation; MDD <= 15% not negotiable; the V4 control's raw +53.14% is not evidence and not a target
binding_rules.universe_clock_costs: frozen 12-ETF cohort, SPY session calendar, S0 window 2018-04-04..2025-07-31, 3 folds per baseline_invariants.json, 10 bps/side base and 20 bps/side stress, ADJ-5 turnover ceiling 6.0 two-way annualized, next-session fills, conditioning-lag rule (+1 session after availability)
required_sections: signed attestation (no forbidden-family ancestry, no outcome knowledge)
binding_rules.control_lesson: L7: a control rank-identical to its anchor cannot identify anything; V4 saw four proposals die pre-selection on measured control self-subsumption (rho 0.78-0.83). Controls must be identifiable and mechanistically distinct BY CONSTRUCTION
binding_rules.aggregation_declaration: if conditioning uses sector aggregates: max_filing_gap_days and the exact field list MUST be declared in the proposal and frozen at family freeze; never tuned after scored PnL

authorized_data.price_volume: 12-ETF snapshot (37 files, MANIFEST 62ac324d...) exactly as V4: {SYM}_none/_all p1, SPY TR benchmark on _all path
authorized_data.pit_conditioning: SEC_EDGAR instant company facts over the frozen 410-filer panel (.staging_sec/panel.json), normalized pit_records.jsonl, conditioning via pit_conditioning.py only
authorized_data.blocked: FRED/ALFRED (key), FINRA (entitlement), Alpha Vantage (key), ECB/BIS (out of scope); any arm reading them fails closed

coverage_census.warmup_rule: fundable_for_d1 = fraction of panel filers with pre-S0 (2018-04-04) availability >= 0.80
coverage_census.sanitizer_note: conflicting-duplicate facts (same accn+end+filed, different val) drop BOTH values (fail-visible; 1.03M of 5.0M raw facts); constant across all arms

attestation_template: I wrote these proposals without access to any V5 scored outcome, any per-arm artifact, or any parameter search over scored results. Every mechanism is checked against the forbidden inventory above. Signature: <agent>
